# italix/cache

> 标签: Opcache, cache, psr-16, redis

## 简介

PSR-16 shaped caching: an opcache-backed file driver, an array driver, and an adapter over any Contracts KeyValueStore

按 require.php 推断最低支持 PHP 7；已收录于 php-v7, php-v8。
